title: Is God real?
claim_under_test: The available evidence does not force either atheism or theism, but belief in God is rationally defensible.

current_assessment.summary: God has not been scientifically disproved or mathematically proven. Philosophical arguments are cumulative; serious objections remain.
current_assessment.certainty_note: Strong on the limits of categorical proof; disputed on the final metaphysical conclusion.

strongest_counterargument: Naturalistic explanations, suffering, divine hiddenness, and religious diversity may explain the evidence without positing God.
what_would_change_the_finding: demonstration that the arguments are logically invalid and naturalistic alternatives explain all cited data better

revision_history.change: Case opened with first-pass deep-dive investigation.
